# James Coombs

> Senior Design Engineer specializing in AI Governance, Agentic Safety Architecture, Design System Migrations at scale, and Web Performance Engineering.

## Context & Core Technical Focus
- **AI Governance & Safety Architecture**: Codified enforcement layers, runtime AST hooks, and active gating for LLM coding agents.
- **Design System Engineering**: Scaling headless component systems (Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Astro, React) and building automated component migration tooling.
- **Performance Engineering**: DOM rendering optimizations, script execution reductions, and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) overhauls.
- **Developer Experience (DX)**: Developer tooling, CLI utilities, and human-in-the-loop workflows bridging cognitive psychology and software architecture.

## Primary Career Systems & Achievements
- [Agentic AI Governance Layer](https://jamescoombs.dev/blog/ai-agent-safety-architecture): Codified safety system for AI agents enforcing runtime hooks and repository standards (Rev).
- [Automated Component Migration Engine](https://jamescoombs.dev/blog/scoring-gating-ratcheting-migration-engine): CLI suite and 15-state bot with 5-factor confidence scoring that safely migrated 962+ files across 44 asset bundles (Rev).
- [High-Performance Transcript Rendering Engine](https://jamescoombs.dev/resume#rev): Architectural overhaul reducing render times by 94% and INP from 3,297ms to 112ms (Rev).
- [Scalable Radix & Tailwind Component System](https://jamescoombs.dev/resume#rev): Enterprise design system scaled from ground zero to 62+ accessible production components (Rev).
- [Algolia & Next.js Dynamic Page Architecture](https://jamescoombs.dev/resume#cervello): Automated dynamic landing page creation pipeline for multi-channel marketing campaigns (Cervello).
